title: Pipe-only browser observation probe

claims.text: The DOM_SNAPSHOT script collects url, data-lin-ready, data-lin-rev, screen, title, h1 headings, status regions, nodes with actions, states and geometry across the whole document.
probe runs the owned pipe client and evaluates snapshots, accessibility data and inventory checks, while viewpoint_probe performs the ViewPoint variant with the same contract validation.
wait_ready and owned_page bound readiness by timeout_ms, and _origin_guard restricts evaluation to the expected origin before collecting evidence.
_inspect cross-checks snapshot nodes against accessibility roles, states and inventory, and _save_artifact persists the bounded evidence under the artifact root.

triggers: screen not ready in DOM snapshot

decision.rule: Change here when the DOM snapshot coverage, readiness waiting, origin guarding or inventory inspection needs to change.
decision.failure: The probe hangs without a timeout, collects elements from the wrong origin, or marks a screen ready before data-lin-ready is set.

questions.q: Where does probe collect the DOM snapshot and check readiness?
Where should I change the timeout and origin guard for page observation?
Where can I debug an inventory mismatch reported by _inspect?
